versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Data Viz Designer skill.
- Supports transforming user data into clear, intuitive charts and visualizations.
- Accepts common data formats (CSV, JSON, Excel) for exploration and analysis.
- Guides chart type selection based on data and user needs.
- Outputs ready-to-use HTML/JS code (ECharts, D3.js, Chart.js) or SVG/PNG images.
- Includes options for customization, detail tuning, and interactive features.
